Singapore's primary work visa for skilled professionals is the Employment Pass. It requires a confirmed job offer from a Singapore registered employer. Your employer applies on your behalf through the Ministry of Manpower. There is no job seeker visa or points based entry system that allows you to arrive and search for work.

This is for exceptionally high earning professionals earning at least SGD 30,000 per month, or those with outstanding achievements in arts, culture, sports, or academia. It does not require a job offer but the salary and achievement threshold is genuinely high.

featured_reviews.review_text:
Updated: This review is subjective, because I had joined the classes (1 month verbal crash course) around 11th November, about 1.5 months before my actual GMAT. and I had also taken only one test offered in the class. (out of 5-6)  Additionally, I had not attended the Quant classes , but had access to few online questions. The questions for Quant looked good, but please use your judgment and maybe do a trial beforehand.
This was the first result from a simple google search for GMAT classes in Mumbai. But overall the classes didn't help me much. There were many important topics which I think weren't covered in the class. Topics such as idioms for sentence correction were not discussed,  practice on "sentence meaning" in sentence correction, techniques in RC were not taught, and for CR techniques like the negation technique in Assumptions and the yes/no technique for evaluation were taught, but reasoning , cause-effect, and practice on hard questions was not sufficient. Practice was provided for major CR type questions though.Resources given were several homework sheets and to do in class sheets,  verbal question bank ( 200 questions, but more like grammar practice), and online tests. The online verbal practice material was easier compared to the actual GMAT and the GMAT prep software. The exercises for basic grammar were okay, but they are not enough for a hard sentence correction question.

Overall, it gave me a start for my studies, but covering major topics and finding tough questions was something I had to do on my own, I realized that after giving GMAT. I had joined the classes presuming that I can give gmat in 1.5 month after completing a 1 month crash course(20hrs) using this class; however, now I have realized that if the amount I had spent for these classes (~20k Rs), had been spent to do self study using books and online tests ( Powerscore CR bible, Manhattan SC guide, Aristotle SC grail, Manhattan RC guide) with a little more time given to self study, then my GMAT results could have been better. I relied too much on these classes which could also be a mistake. This review could be true for all verbal crash course gmat experiences. Hence, I suggest please use your own judgemnet. Thanks for reading, and best of luck for your exams.

featured_reviews.name: Riya Bandivadekar
featured_reviews.review_text: IMS classes provide excellent preparation for CAT exam with strong focus on aptitude test. IMS makes most challenging topics accessible. The structured curriculum and expert guidance instill confidence and ensure thorough preparation. The overall structure and guidance really help build confidence. Highly recommended for serious CAT aspirants!

featured_reviews.name: Rebanto Mazumder
featured_reviews.review_text:
I was enrolled in the MH-CET Preparation Course for 2024/25. All teachers were excellent in terms of subject knowledge and teaching attitude. The extra guidance from teachers was very helpful, who were willing to provide advice and help even beyond class and mentorship hours, and I would like to explicitly thank Jagdish sir, Nishanki ma'am, and Ravi Gupta sir for their time and guidance, not to mention their very positive attitude towards students.

Centre is on the smaller side, but is accommodating of everyone, and they even have a common area for enrolled students looking for a place to self study as well (subject to availability).

Accessibility to the centre is great from Dadar station and is best approached on foot or via two-wheeler.

featured_reviews.name: sanyam samar
featured_reviews.review_text: IMS classes are awesome for CAT prep, especially if you're new to aptitude tests. I wanna give a shoutout to Jagdish Sir. He's fantastic at teaching Quant. He explains complex topics in a simple, and easy-to-grasp manner. The overall teaching approach at IMS is pretty well structured and effective and it helps you boost your confidence. If you're serious about CAT, IMS is certainly a great option.

featured_reviews.name: Mrunal Phatak
featured_reviews.review_text: I am here for ipmat indore 2026...IMS is the best for preparation of ipmat..Ravi Gupta sir (quants sir ) .  nishanky ma'am ( VA ma'am) teaches us very well...Sir explains each and every basic step in quants that makes it easy for us ...even ma'am guides us very well..She gives us many tricks to understand the pattern of this examinations... I would also appreciate benchmarking tests which play best role in preparation...Staff is so calm and polite...They are so good at management..

featured_reviews.name: Jinesh
featured_reviews.review_text: IMS has been helpful in guiding me properly regarding my studies. I had an issue with verbal skills and then after I changed my batch and I got a new Faculty for Verbal. He is very knowledgeable and teaches verbal well. I had attended a few demo lectures which interested my in taking up CAT 2022.I suggest IMS to all my friends because all faculties are good.

featured_reviews.name: Siddhesh mane
featured_reviews.review_text:
I am a student at IMS and I have joined weekend batch of CAT at ims.

My experience at IMS is worst and it is money making institute  .The faculty and teaching experience at IMS is worst.I have paid 72,000 for cat but the teaching is worst. Even after joining the coaching the live coaching I have to go through YouTube channel MBA patshalla which is 10 times better than IMS. IMS is just like showbaji and making false promises. The faculty expects that the students know everything and they teach at a faster pace. We have been telling faculty to slow down the pace but they don't bother at all they just teach for the sack of money.

I will not recommend anyone to join IMS better refer YouTube channel which is much better than IMS which will save your money and time.

featured_reviews.name: The Glocal Journal
featured_reviews.review_text:
The lady at the counter of Dadar is extremely rude and unprofessional. She feels we are doing her a favour by enrolling in the class. She has a lot of attitude and is rude. This has been experienced by many people. She raises her voice and shouts and doesn’t understand at all from students perspective. The faculty is so so good. The verbal isn’t the best at all. Also the SIM cats are very easy.
My suggestion do not take IMS , rather go into you tube and buy online lectures and take time mocks

featured_reviews.name: Tanishq Bhandari
featured_reviews.review_text: IMS is a good place for learning.My verbal score improved because of Mayur Sir.
